chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
"A young person who is generous, though overwhelmed by sins, is more beloved to Allah, Mighty and Majestic, than an old worshipper who is stingy."

key_terms.شَيْخٍ: an old man or elderly person

ai.seo_question: Why is a generous young sinner more beloved to Allah than a stingy old worshipper?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the great moral value of generosity and shows that miserliness can severely diminish the worth of outward worship. It emphasizes that Allah عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ loves noble character, and that sincere generosity may be more beloved than abundant worship accompanied by stinginess.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "A young person who is generous but overwhelmed by sins is more beloved to Allah (swt), the Almighty and Glorious, than an old worshiper who is stingy."
